label: Diagram 17
caption: Diagram 17 One example of a wheelchair-accessible hotel bedroom with en-suite sanitary facilities
description: This is a floor plan titled "Diagram 17 One example of a wheelchair-accessible hotel bedroom with en-suite sanitary facilities". The plan shows a rectangular room divided into a bedroom on the left and a bathroom on the right, with a desk, a cabinet, and a washbasin along the bottom edge. In the bedroom, a bed with a figure is shown on the left, and a chair is positioned at the bottom left. A dashed square labelled "1500mm x 1500mm wheelchair turning space" is located in the center of the room. A central block with two open doors represents a wardrobe. The bathroom on the right is labelled "Wheelchair-accessible shower room or bathroom see Section 5 for details" and contains a figure in a wheelchair, a shower with a seat, a toilet, and a washbasin. Dimensions above the plan read "1500mm min." spanning the bedroom area and "700mm min." spanning the wardrobe opening. A note at top right, "See Section 5 for dimensions", points to the width and depth of the bathroom. On the right, the bathroom door opening is marked vertically with "Effective clear width", and the space beyond the open door is marked horizontally with "300mm min."
